title: Lane Hopper
description: Hop across busy neon highways, rushing rivers, and speeding train tracks. Dodge cars, catch logs, grab coins, and don't linger too long under the shadow of the predator hawk!
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: W/Up/Space: Hop Forward · A/Left: Hop Left · D/Right: Hop Right · S/Down: Hop Back · P: Pause
controls.mobile: Tap: Hop Forward · Swipe Left/Right/Down: Hop in direction
